name: Jesus OG
description:
Rare Michigan Genetics process and proprietary strains have allowed them to achieve many high terpene and THC test results that are only achieved through time and dedication.
If you’re looking for a product that will be unique in appearance coupled with an overwhelming taste and smell profile, they may be the grower for you.
